title: The Surprising Adventures of Baron Munchausen
sourceTitle: The Surprising Adventures of Baron Munchausen
author: Rudolf Erich Raspe
description: "The Surprising Adventures of Baron Munchausen" by Rudolf Erich Raspe is a book published in 1785.
longDescription: This comedic work features impossible tales narrated by a fictional German nobleman loosely based on a real baron known for telling outrageous stories.

authorInfo.bio: Rudolf Erich Raspe (1737–1794) wrote The Surprising Adventures of Baron Munchausen. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
